title: The Rain of Muons
hook: You are being rained on by particles that shouldn't exist.
script: You are being rained on by particles that shouldn't exist. High in the atmosphere, cosmic rays create unstable particles called muons. These particles only live for 2.2 microseconds. That is less time than it takes for a camera flash to pop. Even at near light speed, they should decay long before hitting the ground. But if a clock ticks near light speed, it actually runs slower. This stretches their lifespan just enough to survive the 15 kilometer fall. About one muon passes through every square centimeter of your skin every minute. Einstein's relativity is physically passing through you right now. Do you trust the math, or does this sound like a lie?
